test_cases.name: schema_validation_error
test_cases.input: The tool returned: missing required parameter 'path'. I was trying to read a file.
assertions: Corrects the argument and retries once
Does not enter a retry loop

test_cases.name: rate_limit_429
test_cases.input: GitHub API returned 429 Too Many Requests after listing issues.
assertions: Retries at most once after waiting

test_cases.name: timeout_on_large_payload
test_cases.input: The search tool timed out when I sent a 50-page document.
assertions: Suggests simplifying or splitting the payload
Does not blindly retry the same large call
